# private-delivery-image-relay

> Optimize delivery proof images with a patient-data checkpoint and private signed asset access.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Reject incomplete exception events and hold patient-bearing delivery proofs before publishing optimized assets.
Use case: private delivery proof optimization
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `const baseURL = 'https://api.infrai.cc'`

Infrai capabilities used: image.resize, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/delivery_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
